pages.quiz:
ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — PREMIUM REVISION PAPER #9
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
TIME ALLOWED: 120 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 100
ASSESSMENT: CBC school-based practice paper

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show your working and write the units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the one best answer.
4. Check your work before you hand in.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which surah tells us not to worship what the disbelievers worship? (1 mark)
   A. Al-Ikhlas
   B. Al-Kafirun
   C. Al-Fatiha
   D. An-Nasr

2. Which surah is recited in every rak'ah of the prayer? (1 mark)
   A. Al-Fatiha
   B. An-Nasr
   C. Al-Falaq
   D. Al-Masad

3. Which surah contains the words "You have your religion and I have mine"? (1 mark)
   A. Al-Masad
   B. Al-Kafirun
   C. Al-Ikhlas
   D. An-Nasr

4. What is a hadith? (1 mark)
   A. A saying, action or approval of the Prophet (S.A.W.)
   B. A Muslim festival
   C. A chapter of the Qur'an
   D. A type of prayer

5. Which is NOT a trait of the Prophet? (1 mark)
   A. Generosity
   B. Cheating in trade
   C. Truthfulness
   D. Patience

6. Who was the boy taught the manners of eating in the hadith? (1 mark)
   A. Abu Jahl
   B. Bilal
   C. Umar ibn Abi Salamah
   D. Ali as an old man

7. Which habit protects teeth? (1 mark)
   A. Eating sweets all day
   B. Never rinsing
   C. Sharing toothbrushes
   D. Brushing twice a day

8. In which sport is Kenya most famous for its athletes? (1 mark)
   A. Long-distance running
   B. Gymnastics
   C. Cycling
   D. Swimming

9. Which three skills are named in the syllabus hadith? (1 mark)
   A. Driving, typing and singing
   B. Reading, writing and drawing
   C. Swimming, archery and horse riding
   D. Cooking, sewing and farming

10. According to the hadith, how many names does Allah have that whoever learns and understands them is rewarded? (1 mark)
   A. Twelve
   B. Forty
   C. Ninety-nine
   D. Ten

11. Which is a wrong belief about angels? (1 mark)
   A. That they are Allah's daughters
   B. That they obey Allah
   C. That they carry out duties
   D. That they are made of light

12. What is the duty of Raqib and Atid? (1 mark)
   A. To record our deeds
   B. To take souls
   C. To bring rain
   D. To blow the Trumpet

13. Which angel takes the souls at death? (1 mark)
   A. Malakul Maut
   B. Raqib
   C. Mikail
   D. Jibril

14. Which of these do angels do? (1 mark)
   A. They sometimes disobey
   B. They are Allah's daughters
   C. They eat and sleep
   D. They never disobey Allah

15. How many prophets are named in the Qur'an, as taught at Grade 4? (1 mark)
   A. Forty
   B. Twenty-five
   C. Ninety-nine
   D. Twelve

16. Sulaiman was the son of (1 mark)
   A. Ibrahim
   B. Nuh
   C. Yaqub
   D. Dawud

17. Which two prophets showed obedience when Ibrahim was told in a dream to sacrifice? (1 mark)
   A. Nuh and Hud
   B. Yusuf and Yaqub
   C. Ibrahim and Ismail
   D. Musa and Harun

18. How is a heavy najasa such as dog saliva cleaned? (1 mark)
   A. Sprinkle water once
   B. Wipe with dry cloth
   C. Wash seven times, once with soil
   D. Do nothing

19. Which verse commands wudhu? (1 mark)
   A. Qur'an 110:3
   B. Qur'an 1:2
   C. Qur'an 5:6
   D. Qur'an 112:1

20. How many times do we usually wash each part in wudhu? (1 mark)
   A. Once only for all
   B. Ten
   C. Three
   D. Twenty

21. Which body part is wiped, not washed? (1 mark)
   A. Arms
   B. Face
   C. Hands
   D. Head

22. What should a traveller do if unable to know the Qibla exactly? (1 mark)
   A. Wait a year
   B. Ask no one
   C. Never pray
   D. Try their best and Allah accepts it

23. What must a girl cover during prayer? (1 mark)
   A. Only the head
   B. Nothing
   C. Only the arms
   D. The whole body except face and hands

24. What is the plural of rukn? (1 mark)
   A. Sunan
   B. Arkan
   C. Shuruut
   D. Suwar

25. How can we help birds in the dry season? (1 mark)
   A. Put out water in a dish
   B. Throw stones
   C. Trap them
   D. Break nests

26. What should we say when dressing? (1 mark)
   A. Goodbye
   B. Nothing
   C. Bismillah
   D. Amin

27. What should you do with a message saying school is closed if you are not sure? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore parents
   B. Forward it at once
   C. Check first
   D. Delete school

28. Which is a question to ask before sharing? (1 mark)
   A. Is it funny only?
   B. Will people like me?
   C. Is it new?
   D. Is it true and kind?

29. Which is a good way to help someone who cannot work? (1 mark)
   A. Give zakah and sadaqah
   B. Insult them
   C. Ignore them
   D. Avoid them

30. Which group deserves help? (1 mark)
   A. A person who wants an easy life
   B. A person who lost his farm in a flood
   C. A person who wants toys
   D. A healthy person who refuses to work

31. Which verse says "Call upon Me, I will respond to you"? (1 mark)
   A. Qur'an 112:1
   B. Qur'an 1:1
   C. Qur'an 40:60
   D. Qur'an 110:3

32. What can you do to memorise a dua? (1 mark)
   A. Repeat it line by line with a partner
   B. Never practise
   C. Sleep on it
   D. Read it once

33. Who is a "babu"? (1 mark)
   A. Aunt
   B. Grandfather
   C. Cousin
   D. Grandmother

34. What did the Prophet say when the angel told him to read? (1 mark)
   A. I will read
   B. I am busy
   C. I am tired
   D. I cannot read

35. Which companion stayed with the Prophet in the cave of Thawr? (1 mark)
   A. Bilal
   B. Zayd
   C. Abu Bakr
   D. Ali

36. What does the Qur'an (9:40) mention about the Prophet and Abu Bakr? (1 mark)
   A. They were at Taif
   B. They were in Habasha
   C. They were together in the cave
   D. They were traders

37. What did Khadija notice about Muhammad? (1 mark)
   A. His speed
   B. His honesty and trustworthiness
   C. His wealth
   D. His height

38. What did the Prophet do in the garden? (1 mark)
   A. Ate everything
   B. Made dua to Allah
   C. Cursed them
   D. Fled to another land

39. What is Taif known for? (1 mark)
   A. Cooler weather, gardens and fruit
   B. Beaches
   C. Snow
   D. Deserts only

40. What happened to Taif later? (1 mark)
   A. It disappeared
   B. It was destroyed
   C. Its people accepted Islam in later years
   D. It never changed

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
41. Describe what a siwak is and how it is used. (3 marks)

42. Why did the Prophet (S.A.W.) go to Taif? (2 marks)

43. Explain why we should be kind to Allah's creatures. (4 marks)

44. Write the meaning of the first verse of Surah Al-Ikhlas, "Qul huwallahu ahad". (2 marks)

45. Write the hadith on brushing teeth given in your syllabus. (2 marks)

46. Narrate briefly what happened to the Prophet in Taif. (4 marks)

47. Explain how Prophet Yusuf (A.S.) showed honesty and truthfulness. (3 marks)

48. Explain the meaning of modesty in dressing. (3 marks)

49. How can a child respond politely to a friend who laughs at their modest dress? (3 marks)

50. List three rules for staying safe online. (3 marks)

51. Give three negative uses of media. (3 marks)

52. Explain tartib in swalah. (2 marks)

53. State two creatures of Allah in your environment. (2 marks)

54. Distinguish between a nabi and a rasul. (2 marks)

55. Draw or describe a simple family chart showing at least five relatives and their Kiswahili names. (5 marks)

56. State four teachings from the first five verses of Surah Al-Alaq. (4 marks)

57. What are angels created from, and what do they never do? (2 marks)

58. What can children do for parents who have passed away? (3 marks)

59. Explain how physical fitness helps a Muslim in worship and in daily life. (4 marks)

60. What can a person say if they forget Bismillah at the start of the meal? (2 marks)

61. State the hadith of eating that is in your syllabus. (2 marks)
pages.answers:
ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — PREMIUM REVISION PAPER #9 · MARKING SCHEME
====

SECTION A
----
1. B — Al-Kafirun
   Al-Kafirun states this firmly and ends "For you your religion, for me mine".

2. A — Al-Fatiha
   Al-Fatiha is a pillar of every rak'ah.

3. B — Al-Kafirun
   This is the last verse of Al-Kafirun.

4. A — A saying, action or approval of the Prophet (S.A.W.)
   Hadith records what the Prophet said, did or approved.

5. B — Cheating in trade
   He never cheated on weights or measures.

6. C — Umar ibn Abi Salamah
   He lived in the Prophet's home.

7. D — Brushing twice a day
   Regular brushing prevents cavities.

8. A — Long-distance running
   Kenya is known for its long-distance runners.

9. C — Swimming, archery and horse riding
   The hadith says to teach children these skills.

10. C — Ninety-nine
   The hadith speaks of ninety-nine names.

11. A — That they are Allah's daughters
   Islam rejects this.

12. A — To record our deeds
   They write what a person says and does.

13. A — Malakul Maut
   Malakul Maut is the Angel of Death, also called Izrail.

14. D — They never disobey Allah
   The Qur'an says they do what they are commanded.

15. B — Twenty-five
   Muslims learn twenty-five names.

16. D — Dawud
   Sulaiman was the son of Dawud.

17. C — Ibrahim and Ismail
   Both were ready to obey Allah.

18. C — Wash seven times, once with soil
   This is the method for heavy najasa.

19. C — Qur'an 5:6
   Surah Al-Ma'idah 5:6.

20. C — Three
   The Sunnah is three times.

21. D — Head
   The head is wiped.

22. D — Try their best and Allah accepts it
   Allah does not burden beyond ability.

23. D — The whole body except face and hands
   This is the minimum for girls.

24. B — Arkan
   Arkan means pillars.

25. A — Put out water in a dish
   Birds need water.

26. C — Bismillah
   Say Bismillah for good acts.

27. C — Check first
   Verify news.

28. D — Is it true and kind?
   Truth and kindness first.

29. A — Give zakah and sadaqah
   Islam encourages charity.

30. B — A person who lost his farm in a flood
   Disaster victims deserve help.

31. C — Qur'an 40:60
   Surah Ghafir 40:60.

32. A — Repeat it line by line with a partner
   Practice helps.

33. B — Grandfather
   Babu means grandfather.

34. D — I cannot read
   He was unlettered.

35. C — Abu Bakr
   Abu Bakr was his companion.

36. C — They were together in the cave
   The Qur'an mentions the two in the cave.

37. B — His honesty and trustworthiness
   That is why she respected him.

38. B — Made dua to Allah
   He turned to Allah.

39. A — Cooler weather, gardens and fruit
   It is on higher ground.

40. C — Its people accepted Islam in later years
   A delegation later accepted Islam.

SECTION B
----
41. (3 marks)
   Answer: It is a small stick from a tree such as the arak. One end is chewed to make fibres, and it is rubbed on the teeth.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for stick or tree, 1 mark for chewing the end, 1 mark for rubbing the teeth.

42. (2 marks)
   Answer: To invite the people of Taif to Islam after losing Khadija and Abu Talib.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for inviting and 1 mark for the reason.

43. (4 marks)
   Answer: Allah made them and owns them; kindness earns mercy and reward; animals help us; kindness makes us kind to people.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each valid reason.

44. (2 marks)
   Answer: Say: He is Allah, the One.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for "Say" and 1 mark for "Allah is One".

45. (2 marks)
   Answer: Brushing of teeth is a means of purification of the mouth and pleases Allah.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for purification and 1 mark for pleasing Allah.

46. (4 marks)
   Answer: He invited the leaders and they rejected him rudely, some people threw stones at him and Zayd, his feet bled, and he took shelter in a garden and made dua.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each of four points.

47. (3 marks)
   Answer: He refused to do wrong when tempted, he feared Allah, and stayed honest even in prison. The Qur'an calls him Siddiq.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for refusing wrong, 1 mark for honesty in hardship, 1 mark for Siddiq.

48. (3 marks)
   Answer: Modesty is haya. It means covering properly and dressing decently without showing off.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for haya, 1 mark for covering, 1 mark for not showing off.

49. (3 marks)
   Answer: Stay calm, explain that they dress that way because of their faith, and do not insult back.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for calm, 1 mark for explaining, 1 mark for not insulting.

50. (3 marks)
   Answer: Never share passwords or address, ask parents' permission, tell an adult about anything uncomfortable.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each.

51. (3 marks)
   Answer: Watching harmful content, wasting time, spreading rumours, cyberbullying, unsafe contacts.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each.

52. (2 marks)
   Answer: Doing the pillars in the correct order.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for order and 1 mark for an example.

53. (2 marks)
   Answer: Any two, for example a cow and a bird.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each.

54. (2 marks)
   Answer: A nabi is a prophet who receives revelation; a rasul is a prophet given a message or book to deliver.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each.

55. (5 marks)
   Answer: For example: babu, bibi, baba, shangazi, mjomba, binamu, each placed correctly.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct relative up to 5.

56. (4 marks)
   Answer: Seek knowledge; read in Allah's name; Allah is the Creator and Most Generous; writing is important; we learn what we did not know.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each.

57. (2 marks)
   Answer: They are created from light and they never disobey Allah.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each part.

58. (3 marks)
   Answer: Make dua for them, give charity on their behalf, keep good relations with their friends and relatives.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each.

59. (4 marks)
   Answer: It makes prayer postures, fasting and walking to the mosque easier. It also gives strength for work and helping others.
   Working / marking points: 2 marks for worship points and 2 marks for daily life points.

60. (2 marks)
   Answer: "Bismillahi awwalahu wa akhirahu" meaning "In the name of Allah at its beginning and its end."
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the words and 1 mark for the meaning.

61. (2 marks)
   Answer: Mention the name of Allah, eat with your right hand, and eat what is directly in front of you.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the first two teachings and 1 mark for the third, or 1 mark each for correct halves.
